meta.name: dev-release
meta.description: Release preparation — changelog generation, version bump, tag creation. Generic version (not project-specific). For EvoNexus releases, use custom-release instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成变更日志、升级版本号并创建标签
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版前都要手动整理变更和打标签
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate changelog, bump version, and create tags
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually manage changelogs and version bumps before each release

howto.what: 装好后，你让 Claude 发布项目新版本，它就会自动生成变更日志、更新版本号、创建 Git 标签，并保存发布说明。
howto.when: 当你要求准备发布一个非 EvoNexus 的项目（如通用库），且当前分支干净、代码通过测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目发布一个新版本
say.note: 自动检测当前版本并询问升级类型

say.text: 生成 v1.2.0 的 changelog 并打标签
say.note: 指定版本号，直接开始对应流程

say.text: 为当前库做一次补丁版本发布
say.note: 指定 patch 类型，简化确认

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to prepare a release for a non-EvoNexus project, it will automatically generate a changelog from git log, bump the version, create a Git tag, and save release notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a release for a non-EvoNexus project (e.g., a generic library) and the working tree is clean and tests pass.

say_en.text: Prepare a new release for this project.
say_en.note: Auto-detects current version and asks for bump type.

say_en.text: Generate changelog and tag for v1.2.0.
Do a patch release for this library.
say_en.note: Specifies patch bump to reduce confirmation steps.
